title: Delivery preference
body: Daughter prefers deliveries before 2 PM — she meets the vendor at the side door.

title: O2 filter check
body: O2 concentrator running louder than usual last visit. Flagged vendor for filter check on next route.

title: Discharge pickup
body: Discharge window is tight Saturday morning. Confirm hospital bed pickup is scheduled after family leaves.

title: Commode placement
body: Family asked for a commode closer to the recliner — consider second unit if mobility worsens.

title: Bed alarm
body: Wandering risk increased — ensure bed alarm pad stays plugged in after vendor visits.

title: Dialysis schedule
body: Dialysis days are Tue/Thu/Sat — avoid scheduling DME deliveries those mornings if possible.

title: Mobility staging
body: Stroke recovery — left-side weakness. All mobility aids should stay on patient's right when staging equipment.

title: Monday discharge
body: Discharge Monday 8 AM. Pre-stage pickup for wheelchair and concentrator Sunday evening if vendor can.
